app.name: Dulja
app.error.title: Something went wrong
auth.login.title: Sign in
auth.login.failed: That e-mail and password did not match an account.
auth.mfa.title: Set up two-factor authentication
auth.mfa.intro: Scan this code with your authenticator app, then type the six digits it shows.
auth.mfa.required: Two-factor authentication is required before you can continue.
auth.mfa.done: Two-factor authentication is on. You can continue to the back office.
auth.mfa.challengeIntro: Enter the six digits your authenticator app is showing.
auth.mfa.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
auth.mfa.secret: Or type this setup key into your authenticator app
auth.mfa.failed: That code did not match. Check your authenticator app and try again.
auth.mfa.unavailable: Two-factor authentication could not be set up just now. Check your connection and try again.
auth.reset.start: First time here, or forgot your password?
auth.reset.title: Set your password
auth.reset.requestIntro: Enter the e-mail address you were invited with. We will e-mail you a one-time code.
auth.reset.sent: If an account uses this address, a one-time code is on its way. Type it below.
auth.reset.codeFailed: That code is wrong or has expired. Check the latest e-mail or send a new code.
auth.reset.mismatch: The two passwords are not the same.
auth.reset.weak: That password is too weak. Choose a longer one that is harder to guess.
auth.reset.samePassword: Choose a password different from your current one.
auth.reset.mfaIntro: Your account uses two-factor authentication. Enter the six digits your authenticator app shows to confirm the change.
auth.reset.rateLimited: Too many requests. Wait a minute, then try again.
auth.reset.unavailable: That could not be done just now. Check your connection and try again.
auth.session.memoryOnly: This computer cannot store your sign-in securely, so it was not saved. You will need to sign in again the next time the app starts.
admin.users.title: Users and roles
admin.users.count: {count, plural, =0 {No users} one {# user} other {# users}}
admin.users.countOfPage: {count, plural, =0 {No users on this page} one {# user on this page} other {# users on this page}}
admin.users.morePages: There are more users than this page shows, and search looks only at the ones listed here.
admin.users.emptyPage: Nothing to show on this page.
admin.users.listUnavailable: The list of users could not be loaded.
admin.users.column.name: Name
admin.users.selectPrompt: Press Enter on a row to choose who to assign a role to.
admin.users.companyUnknown: Assigning a role is unavailable until the company for this account is known.
problem.ERR_INTERNAL.title: The server could not complete that request
problem.ERR_INTERNAL.remedy: Try it again. If it keeps happening, quote the reference below when you contact support.
problem.ERR_RBAC_FORBIDDEN.title: You do not have permission to do that
problem.ERR_RBAC_FORBIDDEN.remedy: Ask an administrator to grant you the permission this action needs.
problem.ERR_RBAC_SELF_GRANT.title: You cannot give yourself a role
problem.ERR_RBAC_SELF_GRANT.remedy: Ask another administrator to make this assignment.
problem.ERR_RBAC_SELF_ESCALATION.title: You cannot give yourself more permission than you hold
problem.ERR_RBAC_SELF_ESCALATION.remedy: Ask an administrator who already holds that permission to make this assignment.
problem.ERR_RBAC_KIND.title: That role does not fit this kind of account
problem.ERR_RBAC_KIND.remedy: Choose a role meant for this kind of account.
problem.ERR_CONFLICT_REFERENCE.title: Something this refers to is missing
problem.ERR_CONFLICT_REFERENCE.remedy: Check that the person and the role both still exist, then try again.
tax.title: Tax returns
tax.invalid: Choose a regime and valid period dates; the end must follow the start.
tax.label: Description
tax.draft: Generate this draft to calculate its boxes and reconciliation.
problem.ERR_TAX_REGIME_MISMATCH.title: Tax regime does not match
problem.ERR_TAX_REGIME_MISMATCH.remedy: Check the selected regime, version and tax codes.
problem.ERR_POLICY_REQUIRES_MISSING.titl: Required information is missing or invalid
problem.ERR_POLICY_REQUIRES_MISSING.reme: Check the fields named in the message. A tax return must cover complete fiscal periods.
problem.ERR_DOC_STATUS_ILLEGAL.title: Current status does not allow this action
problem.ERR_DOC_STATUS_ILLEGAL.remedy: Read the current status. A filed tax return cannot be regenerated.
problem.ERR_CONFLICT_UNIQUE.title: This record already exists
problem.ERR_CONFLICT_UNIQUE.remedy: Check existing records before creating another with the same unique values.
problem.ERR_VALIDATION_FAILED.title: Request failed validation
problem.ERR_NOT_FOUND.title: Record not found
problem.ERR_NOT_FOUND.remedy: Refresh the list and select an available record.
staff.loadFailed: Unable to load staff data. Check your access and retry.
staff.amountHint: Amount in {currency}; leave optional limits blank to clear them.
staff.blindAllowed: Allow returns without an original ticket
staff.saveFailed: Unable to save. Check the values and your authority, then retry.
staff.revokeQuestion: Revoke the till credential of {cashier}? They will no longer sign in at any till.
staff.assignRoleHint: Assign cashier authority through Users and roles after creating the credential.
staff.pinHint: Press Enter in this field to submit. Leaving the field clears the PIN.
pos.title: Point of sale
pos.bridgeMissing: Open this till in the Dulja POS desktop app.
pos.localTotals: Local settled tenders; final expected cash and over/short are calculated by the server after sync.
pos.blind: Leave the reference empty only for an authorised blind return.
pos.empty: Scan or search for an item to start.
pos.name: Customer name
pos.creditHint: Account checks cover this till’s pending sales. The server also checks the customer’s outstanding balance.
pos.subject: Approval subject
pos.cashHint: Cash-only payments use the branch’s rounding increment. Mixed payments settle the original total. Referenced returns preserve the original amounts.
pos.error: The operation was refused. Review the details and try again.
pos.error.ERR_RATE_LIMITED: Too many wrong PINs were entered. PIN entry is paused for now; try again later.
pos.error.ERR_TERMINAL_ENROLMENT_INVALID: That enrolment code was not accepted. Check it against the back office; if it has expired or was already used, ask for a new one.
pos.error.ERR_TILL_PIN_INVALID: That PIN does not match a cashier on this till.
pos.error.ERR_TILL_CATALOGUE_STALE: This till has not updated its catalogue and cannot price a ticket.
pos.error.ERR_TILL_STORE_CORRUPT: This till's local database is damaged. Call support before selling.
pos.error.ERR_RBAC_FORBIDDEN: You are not allowed to do that at this till.
pos.error.ERR_VALIDATION_FAILED: That is not a valid entry.
pos.error.ERR_MONEY_CURRENCY_MISMATCH: Those amounts are in different currencies.
pos.error.ERR_INTERNAL: Something went wrong. Try again, and call support if it happens twice.
pos.syncAttention: Sync needs attention. Tell your branch manager if this message stays.
pos.reviewCount: Check the count before closing the shift. A close is final, and the over/short is posted from this count.
pos.countLooksLikeScan: That looked like a barcode scan, not a typed amount. Type the amount.
pos.receiptUnavailable: The sale is complete, but its receipt could not be shown.
pos.syncFailed: Sync failed. The till keeps your sales and will try again.
pos.shortcuts: F2 price check · F4 customers · F8 review · F10 shift · Escape back
pos.returnToAccount: This sale was on the customer’s account, so the refund is credited to that account. Pay nothing out of the drawer.
pos.priceCheckQuery: Scan a barcode, or type a code or name
shift.title: Shift register
shift.chooseDates: Choose a date range to view cashier sales.
report.title: Reports
report.name: Report
report.empty: No report definitions are available to this company.
report.companyUnknown: The company could not be determined for your account, so nothing can be shown here.
report.notFound: This report definition was not found in this company.
report.status.failed: The report could not be produced
report.param.title: Parameters
report.param.idHint: Type the record's identifier; the list of choices could not be read with your permissions.
report.param.listTruncated: The list shows the first {count} choices. To choose any other record, type or paste its identifier here.
report.run.title: Run a report
report.run.none: This report has not been run yet.
report.view.title: Saved views
report.view.save: Save these parameters as a view (Ctrl+S)
report.designer.title: Report designer
report.designer.coreReadOnly: This is a standard report and cannot be changed. Clone it to make a company copy you can edit.
report.designer.archivedReadOnly: This copy is archived and cannot be changed. Clone it to edit a new copy.
report.designer.saved: Changes saved. The next run uses them.
report.designer.unsavedQuestion: This copy has changes that are not saved. Discard them?
report.designer.columnsHint: Alt+Up and Alt+Down move the column the cursor is in. A hidden column is left out of the report and can be shown again.
report.designer.placeholders: May include '{title}', '{code}', '{rowCount}', '{generatedAt}' and a parameter name in braces.
report.keys: Enter runs the report the cursor is on; Shift+Enter opens it in the designer; / moves to the filter.
admin.export.title: Data export
admin.export.intro: Export this company's data as CSV and JSON files with a documented schema, in one archive. Only the tables and attachments your permissions allow are included; any table left out is listed with the permission it needs.
admin.export.excludedHint: These tables are not in the archive because you do not hold the permission named beside each. The export is incomplete without them.
admin.export.excludedRowsHint: These tables are in the archive, but without the rows of one module's documents, because you do not hold the permission named beside each. The export is incomplete without them.
admin.export.failed: The archive could not be built. Request a new export; the failed one is kept as it is.
admin.export.none: You have not requested an export yet.
hr.record.title: Employee HR record
hr.record.heading: HR record — {number}
hr.sensitive.title: Identity and bank details
hr.sensitive.denied: You do not have access to identity and bank details.
hr.sensitive.none: No identity or bank details are recorded for this employee yet.
hr.sensitive.hint: Only the fields you change are sent. Clearing a field removes the stored value. You cannot change your own record.
hr.profile.title: Statutory profile
hr.profile.denied: You do not have access to statutory profiles.
hr.profile.none: No statutory profile is recorded yet.
hr.profile.childReliefInvalid: Enter a whole number of children, or leave it blank.
hr.profile.closesHint: Saving opens a new profile from this date and closes the current one the day before. The current profile is not edited.
hr.compensation.title: Compensation
hr.compensation.denied: You do not have access to compensation.
hr.compensation.none: No compensation lines are recorded yet.
hr.compensation.invalid: Enter a positive number with at most four decimal places for an amount, or six for a quantity.
hr.compensation.noComponents: There is no active pay component to choose. Create one under Pay components first.
hr.compensation.closesHint: Saving closes this component's current line the day before the new date. The current line is not edited.
hr.payComponent.title: Pay components
hr.payComponent.intro: What the company pays and deducts. A component's code and kind are fixed once it is created; retire one by archiving it.
hr.payComponent.denied: You do not have access to the pay-component catalogue.
hr.payComponent.name: Name
hr.payComponent.schemesHint: A scheme added here cannot be removed. To withdraw one, archive the component and create a replacement.
hr.payComponent.schemesDenied: You do not have access to the statutory schemes.
hr.payComponent.fixedHint: The code and kind cannot be changed after saving.
hr.scheme.title: Statutory tables
hr.scheme.intro: Statutory schemes and their versioned rate tables. A table someone loads stays unverified until a different person verifies it.
hr.scheme.denied: You do not have access to the statutory tables.
hr.scheme.none: No statutory schemes are set up for this company.
hr.scheme.name: Name
hr.rateTable.title: Rate tables
hr.rateTable.heading: Rate tables — {code}
hr.rateTable.none: No rate table has been loaded for this scheme.
hr.rateTable.definition: Definition, as it will be used
hr.rateTable.ownLoad: Verification requires a different principal: you loaded this table.
hr.rateTable.verifyHint: Check the definition against the authority's publication before you verify it. A verified table cannot be changed.
hr.rateTable.loadHint: Paste the table's definition. It is checked against the rate-table schema and stored unverified.
hr.rateTable.malformed: This is not valid JSON. Check the pasted text.
hr.settings.title: HR settings
hr.settings.intro: Company payroll conventions your accountant confirms, and the employer registration number for each statutory scheme.
hr.settings.denied: You do not have access to the company's HR settings.
hr.settings.payDayHint: 1 to 31, or blank until it is confirmed.
hr.settings.payDayInvalid: Enter a day from 1 to 31, or leave it blank.
hr.settings.registrationsHint: Leave a number blank until the owner supplies it; nothing is refused while one is missing.
payroll.title: Payroll runs
payroll.intro: Each run is a payroll document: calculate it as a draft, check it, then submit it. A different person approves and posts it.
payroll.denied: You do not have access to payroll runs.
payroll.employeesHint: A regular run takes every employee employed in the period. A supplementary or final run names its employees.
payroll.employeesDenied: You do not have access to the employee list.
payroll.heading: Payroll run — {start} to {end}
payroll.noPins: No statutory scheme on this run
payroll.postedHint: This run is posted. A correction is a supplementary run; a posted run is never edited.
payroll.returnReason: Reason for returning it to draft
payroll.approveHint: Approval needs a different person from the one who submitted the run.
payroll.recalculateHint: Recalculating a submitted run returns it to draft; it must then be submitted and approved again.
payroll.overridesNone: No manual override on this run.
payroll.changesHint: Everyone who changed an employee's compensation effective inside this period. Check these before approving.
payroll.changesNone: No compensation change is effective inside this period.
payroll.override.none: This run has no computed statutory share to override.
payroll.override.hint: Replaces one employee's computed share with the figure you enter, with a reason. The run is recalculated at once and the override is listed for the approver.
payroll.override.invalid: Enter a non-negative amount with at most four decimal places.
payslip.title: Payslips
payslip.hint: One PDF per employee, rendered and hashed by the server and kept on this run. Each generation stores new files; earlier ones are never replaced.
payslip.none: The run paid none of the chosen employees.
payslip.earlierNone: No payslip has been generated for this run yet.
payslip.earlierDenied: You may not list this run's payslips: listing them needs the payroll read permission.
permit.title: Work permit expiry
permit.intro: Employees whose work permit expires within the window, soonest first; a lapsed permit is always listed. Contract end dates are the Contract expiry report.
permit.withinInvalid: Enter a whole number of days from 0 to 3650.
permit.denied: You need the right to read sensitive employee details (hr.employee.read_sensitive) to see permit dates.
permit.none: No work permit expires within {days} days.
permit.name: Name
leave.title: Leave register
leave.intro: A record of leave, never a pay input: a request is approved or rejected by someone other than the employee. Entitlements are entered by HR; nothing accrues.
leave.recordsHint: Approve or reject a request from its row. You cannot decide your own leave; a decided record is final.
leave.daysHint: Whole or half days, for example 2 or 1.5.
leave.daysInvalid: Enter a number of days with at most two decimal places.
leave.denied: You do not have access to the leave register.
leave.recordDenied: You need the right to keep the leave register (hr.leave.record) to see this.
leave.typesDenied: Leave types are shown to holders of hr.leave.record.
leave.typesNone: No leave types yet. Add one under Leave types first.
leave.entitlementsHint: The days each employee is entitled to in a year, entered by HR. Saving again replaces the figure.
leave.entitlementInvalid: Enter a year from 2000 to 2200 and days with at most two decimal places.
leave.holidaysHint: A holiday for every branch, or for one branch. You see company-wide holidays and those of your branches.
leave.keys: Arrow keys move through the records; Enter on a request opens its decision, where Approve has the cursor and Esc closes it.
leave.incomplete: Not every row could be read, so this list may be incomplete.
payslip.keys: Arrow keys move through the payslips; Enter on a row downloads its PDF.
payslip.incomplete: Only the first 1,000 files on this run are listed, so newer payslips may be missing.
